title: When belonging becomes management
subtitle: For the urge to run even the room that helps you
description: These readings warn that even good company can be turned into a project for control if the self refuses to be corrected.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Sangat is meant to turn the heart toward the Lord, not give the ego another room to manage.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let the gathering correct you before deciding how everyone else should move.

evidence.coreClaim: This path catches control as it enters belonging and tries to govern the very company meant to heal it.
evidence.turn: Sangat works when the heart receives formation instead of managing the atmosphere.
evidence.practicalImplication: In the next gathering, listen for the correction meant for you before offering one to anyone else.
